ideas.title: Node.js Fails to Start a Published CLI with Error: Cannot find module '/package.json'
ideas.description: A packaged CLI crashes because the entrypoint resolves package metadata from the wrong location.
ideas.angle: Explain how bundled CLIs often read `package.json` through `import.meta.url`, `__dirname`, or a relative path that breaks after publish. Show how the module layout changes in `npm pack`, why the file is missing from the tarball or resolved from CWD, and how to fix the path handling and package files.

ideas.title: Cloudflare Workers Reject `crypto.createHash()` with `ReferenceError: crypto is not defined`
ideas.description: A Node crypto API crashes in Workers because the runtime exposes Web Crypto, not `node:crypto` globals.
ideas.angle: Cover the runtime mismatch between Node’s `crypto` module and the Web Crypto API available in Workers. Explain why top-level `crypto.createHash()` or `require('crypto')` fails, what APIs are supported instead, and how to replace hashing with `subtle.digest()` or a compatible library.

drafted.title: Hono Cannot Match `c.req.param()` When a Static Route Shadows a Dynamic One
drafted.description: Route order in Hono can hide dynamic params and make `c.req.param()` return empty values.
drafted.angle: Cover Hono’s route precedence, how a static path can shadow a parameterized route, and why the handler still runs without the expected params. Explain how to reorder routes, use distinct prefixes, and confirm the matched pattern before reading params.
